scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --var QUICKLOGIN_SERVER_BUILD:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var RELEASE:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.check:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:do && npm run check:api && npm run lint:api && npm run check:boundaries && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run check:design && npm test && npm run test:do
scripts.build:ci: npm --prefix frontend run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run check:ci && npm run test:container && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run typecheck:e2e && VITE_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN= VITE_POSTHOG_HOST= npm --prefix frontend run build && node e2e/run.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:school: npm run typecheck:e2e && tsc -p e2e/school/tsconfig.json && VITE_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN= VITE_POSTHOG_HOST= npm --prefix frontend run build && node e2e/school/build.mjs && node e2e/school/run.mjs
